# llms.txt - AI Agent Guide for tanmay.dev
# This file helps AI agents understand and navigate this site's content

## Site Overview
- **Site**: https://tanmay.dev
- **Author**: Tanmay Mohan (Cloud Physicist)
- **Description**: Personal blog and documentation site covering cloud infrastructure, GPU workloads, cost optimization, Kubernetes/EKS security, and AI/ML infrastructure.
- **Primary Language**: English (also available in Hindi at /hi/)

## Content Structure

### Blog Posts (/blog/)
Technical articles and learnings from real-world experience. Key topics:
- GPU workloads on various cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Brev, Verda, E2E Networks, local)
- Cloud cost optimization strategies and case studies
- EKS hardening and security practices
- MLOps, LLMOps, and inference serving
- Kubernetes and container orchestration
- Cloud migrations and infrastructure decisions

### Documentation Guides (/docs/)
Structured, in-depth guides organized into series:

#### 1. Running GPUs in 2026 (/docs/running-gpus-in-2026/)
Practical guides for running GPU workloads across providers:
- Brev by NVIDIA (multi-cloud, Launchables, NIM)
- Verda (Europe, latest GPUs, spot pricing)
- E2E Networks (India, H100/H200)
- AWS (EC2 P5/P4/G6, global)
- Google Cloud (Compute Engine, Vertex AI)
- Local machine (desktop/workstation GPUs)

#### 2. Cloud Cost Optimization Playbook (/docs/cost-optimization-playbook/)
Systematic approach to AWS cost reduction:
- Compute (right-sizing, spot, Savings Plans, Karpenter)
- Database (RDS optimization, service migration)
- Storage (GP2→GP3, S3 Intelligent Tiering, EBS cleanup)
- Networking (VPC endpoints, NAT Gateway costs)
- Monitoring (CloudWatch costs, open-source alternatives)

#### 3. EKS Security Hardening (/docs/eks-security-hardening/)
Layered security approach for EKS clusters:
- Node Security (Bottlerocket, no SSH, AMI management)
- Pod Security (IRSA, Pod Identity, secrets management)
- Network Security (Private API, VPN-only kubectl, WAF)
- CI/CD Security (SonarCloud, Trivy, branch protection)
- Cluster Upgrades (version upgrades, addon compatibility)

#### 4. AWS Account & Access Setup (/docs/aws-account-setup/)
Production-grade AWS account configuration:
- IAM Identity Center (SSO with Google Workspace)
- Permission Sets (role-based access design)
- EKS Requirements (Karpenter, addons, logging)
- Account Services (VPC, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront)
- Governance (SCPs, CloudTrail, tagging strategy)

## Key Pages
- **Homepage** (/): Hero with links to Blog and GPU Docs
- **About** (/about/): Author bio, focus areas, links
- **Blog Archive** (/blog/archive/): All posts by date
- **Tags** (/blog/tags/): Filter by topic (GPU, Cost, Kubernetes, AWS, Security, MLOps, etc.)

## For AI Agents
- All content is in Markdown/MDX format
- Blog posts have frontmatter: slug, title, authors, tags, date
- Docs have frontmatter: sidebar_position, slug
- Code blocks use Prism syntax highlighting
- Mermaid diagrams are rendered for architecture visuals
- Tables are wrapped for horizontal scrolling on mobile
- Images support lightbox zoom

## Accessibility
- Semantic HTML structure
- Alt text on images
- Skip to main content link
- Color mode respects system preference
- Responsive design
